title: AttributeList
description: NGSI-LD AttributeList data type (ETSI GS CIM 009 clause 5.2.27). The attribute list representation returned by GET /attributes (clause 4.5.13). Not subject to options=concise/keyValues.

id.description: URI that is unique within the system scope. Identifier for the attribute list.

type.description: JSON-LD @type. It shall be equal to "AttributeList".
